name: Old Faithful Fixes
description: Fixes b1.7.3's own clear mistakes, the way the game was meant to work: the grey sky with a chest open, tools whose last use drops nothing, wooden slabs that need a pickaxe, the furnace eating the lava bucket, and more. Each fix has its own switch, in Options > Old Faithful... (with Old Faithful Options) or config/oldfaithful-fixes.properties.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
